text:
Inorder traversal (Data Structures)

Visit the left subtree first, then the node itself, then the right subtree. On a binary search tree it visits the keys in sorted order, smallest to largest. Recursive version: inorder(n.left); print(n.key); inorder(n.right).

Preorder traversal (Data Structures)

Visit the node first, then the left subtree, then the right subtree. Use it to copy a tree or to save a tree to a file, because the parent always comes before its children. On an expression tree it gives the prefix form.

Postorder traversal (Data Structures)

Left subtree, then right subtree, then the node last. Children are processed before the parent, so use it to delete a whole tree safely or to evaluate an expression tree. On an expression tree it gives the postfix form.

BST: insert, search, delete (CS 2 notes)

Binary search tree rule: everything in the left subtree is smaller than the node, everything in the right subtree is bigger. Search and insert: compare with the node then go left or right until you find the key or an empty spot.

Delete may have 3 cases. Case 1: leaf, just remove it. Case 2: one child, ipalit ang child sa pwesto ng node. Case 3: dalawang child, palitan ang node ng inorder successor (pinakamaliit sa right subtree) tapos i-delete ang successor sa dating pwesto niya.

Time: average O(log n) pero kapag sorted ang pinasok na keys (1,2,3,4...) nagiging parang linked list na skewed, O(n) na ang search. Prof said the exam will ask us to draw the tree after inserting 8 keys and then delete the root, so practice this.

Stack vs Queue

Stack = LIFO (last in, first out). Operations: push, pop, peek. Gamit: undo, function call stack, pagtingin kung balanced ang parentheses.

Queue = FIFO (first in, first out). Operations: enqueue sa likod, dequeue sa harap. Gamit: printer jobs, BFS, pila sa cashier. Circular queue para hindi masayang ang array space.

Hash tables

A hash function turns a key into an array index (key mod table size). Two keys landing on the same index is a collision. Chaining: each slot holds a linked list. Open addressing: probe for the next free slot (linear probing, quadratic probing, double hashing). Load factor = items / slots; rehash when it goes above about 0.7. Average lookup is O(1).

Sorting algorithms, cheat sheet

Bubble sort O(n^2), simple lang pero mabagal. Insertion sort O(n^2) pero mabilis sa almost-sorted na list. Merge sort O(n log n) always, kailangan ng extra space (divide, sort halves, merge). Quick sort O(n log n) average, O(n^2) worst case kapag masama ang pivot. Heap sort O(n log n), in-place. Stable: merge, insertion, bubble. Not stable: quick, heap.

Linked list vs array

Array: random access by index in O(1), but inserting in the middle shifts elements, O(n), and the size is fixed. Singly linked list: each node has data and a next pointer; insert at head is O(1), but you must walk the list to reach the k-th item. Doubly linked list adds a prev pointer so you can go backwards, at the cost of extra memory.

Math 101: derivatives

Power rule: d/dx x^n = n x^(n-1). Product rule: (uv)' = u'v + uv'. Chain rule: d/dx f(g(x)) = f'(g(x)) g'(x). Example: d/dx (3x^2 + 1)^4 = 4(3x^2+1)^3 * 6x.

Passing grade is 75%. Prof. Reyes moved the quiz to Monday; it covers limits and derivatives. Bring a scientific calculator.

Math 101: limits and continuity

The limit of f(x) as x approaches a is the value f gets close to, kahit hindi defined ang f sa a mismo. If you get 0/0, factor and cancel, or use L'Hopital's rule (derivative of top over derivative of bottom). One-sided limits must agree for the limit to exist. A function is continuous at a if the limit equals f(a). Limit as x goes to infinity of 1/x is 0.

Algebra: quadratic equations

For ax^2 + bx + c = 0, the roots are x = (-b +/- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a. Ang b^2 - 4ac ay tinatawag na discriminant: positive means two real roots, zero means one repeated root, negative means no real roots (complex). Sum of roots = -b/a, product of roots = c/a. Completing the square is the same idea but step by step.

Integrals (Calculus 2)

Ang integral ay kabaligtaran ng derivative. Antiderivative of x^n is x^(n+1)/(n+1) + C, except n = -1 which gives ln|x|. Definite integral from a to b gives the area under the curve: F(b) - F(a). Substitution: piliin ang u na ang derivative ay nasa loob din ng integral, tapos palitan ang dx. Integration by parts: integral of u dv = uv - integral of v du.

Physics 1: kinematics (constant acceleration)

v = v0 + at. d = v0 t + (1/2) a t^2. v^2 = v0^2 + 2ad. Free fall: a = g = 9.8 m/s^2 downward, ignore air resistance. At the top of a thrown-up object's path v = 0 but the acceleration is still g. Example: dropped from rest for 3 s falls d = 0.5 * 9.8 * 9 = 44.1 m.

Physics 1: Newton's laws

1st law (inertia): an object keeps its motion unless a net force acts on it. 2nd law: F = ma, so net force ay katumbas ng mass times acceleration. 3rd law: for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction (nasa magkaibang object ang dalawang force, kaya hindi sila nagka-cancel).

Weight W = mg. Normal force is perpendicular to the surface. Kinetic friction f = mu_k N, static friction maximum is mu_s N. Draw a free body diagram first, then sum the forces in x and y separately. Sample: 5 kg box pulled with 20 N, friction 5 N, a = (20-5)/5 = 3 m/s^2.

Physics 1: work, energy and power

Work W = F d cos(theta), measured in joules. Kinetic energy KE = (1/2) m v^2. Potential energy PE = mgh. Conservation of mechanical energy when there is no friction. Power P = W/t in watts; 746 W is one horsepower. Work-energy theorem: net work equals change in kinetic energy.

Organic Chem: naming alkanes (IUPAC)

Stem names: meth (1 C), eth (2), prop (3), but (4), pent (5), hex (6), hept (7), oct (8), non (9), dec (10). Alkane ends in -ane, general formula CnH2n+2.

Steps: 1) hanapin ang pinakamahabang tuloy-tuloy na carbon chain, yan ang parent. 2) Bilangin mula sa dulo na nagbibigay ng pinakamababang number sa unang substituent. 3) Pangalanan ang mga branch (methyl, ethyl, propyl) at ilagay ang number bago ang pangalan. 4) Alphabetical ang order ng mga substituent, ignore di-, tri- prefixes. Example: 2,3-dimethylpentane. Cycloalkanes get the prefix cyclo- and have formula CnH2n. Isomers have the same formula but different structure, e.g. butane and isobutane (2-methylpropane).

Organic Chem: functional groups

Alcohol -OH (suffix -ol). Aldehyde -CHO at the end of a chain (-al). Ketone C=O inside the chain (-one). Carboxylic acid -COOH (-oic acid). Ester -COOR. Amine -NH2. Ether R-O-R. Alkene has C=C, alkyne has C triple bond C. Hydroxyl groups make a molecule polar and able to hydrogen bond, so alcohols boil higher than alkanes of the same size.

Organic Chem: SN1 vs SN2

SN2: one step, the nucleophile attacks from the back side while the leaving group leaves, kaya inversion of configuration. Rate = k[substrate][nucleophile]. Best with methyl and primary carbons, strong nucleophile, polar aprotic solvent (DMSO, acetone). SN1: two steps, the leaving group leaves first to form a carbocation, then the nucleophile attacks, so racemization. Rate depends only on the substrate. Best with tertiary carbons and polar protic solvents (water, ethanol).

Organic Chem: E1 vs E2 elimination

E2: one step, strong base takes a beta hydrogen at the same time the leaving group leaves, needs anti-periplanar geometry. Rate depends on both the substrate and the base. E1: carbocation first (same as SN1), then a weak base removes a beta hydrogen, so it competes with SN1. Zaitsev's rule: the more substituted alkene is the major product. Heat favors elimination over substitution.

General Chem: chemical bonding

Ionic bond: transfer of electrons between a metal and a nonmetal (NaCl); the compound is a crystal lattice with high melting point. Covalent bond: sharing of electrons between nonmetals (H2O, CH4). Polar covalent when the electronegativity difference is between 0.4 and 1.7. A single bond is one shared pair, a double bond is two pairs, a triple bond is three pairs; more shared pairs means a shorter, stronger bond. Octet rule: atoms want 8 valence electrons.

Filipino: aspekto ng pandiwa

Ang pandiwa ay may tatlong aspekto. Perpektibo (naganap na): kumain, nagluto, sumulat. Imperpektibo (nagaganap pa): kumakain, nagluluto, sumusulat; inuulit ang unang pantig ng salitang-ugat. Kontemplatibo (magaganap pa lamang): kakain, magluluto, susulat. May iba pang aspekto na tinatawag na perpektibong katatapos, gaya ng kakakain, na ginagamit kapag kasasagawa lang ng kilos.

Paalala ng guro: sa pagsusulit, bibigyan tayo ng pangungusap at tutukuyin kung anong aspekto ang pandiwa. Ang salitang-ugat ay hindi pa pandiwa hangga't wala itong panlapi, halimbawa ang 'kain' at ang 'sulat'. Huwag malito sa pokus ng pandiwa, iba ang paksang iyon na pag-aaralan sa susunod na linggo.

Filipino: mga pang-ugnay

Pangatnig (at, o, ngunit, dahil, kaya) ay nag-uugnay ng salita, parirala o sugnay. Pang-angkop (na, -ng, -g) ay nag-uugnay ng panuring sa salitang tinuturingan: magandang bata, batang mabait. Pang-ukol (sa, ni, kay, para sa, ayon sa) ay nag-uugnay ng pangngalan sa ibang salita sa pangungusap. Ginagamit ang -ng kapag nagtatapos sa patinig, na kapag sa katinig, at -g kapag nagtatapos sa n.

History: Spanish colonial period, notes

Encomienda: land and the people on it entrusted to a Spaniard (encomendero) who collected tribute and was supposed to protect and convert them; abused a lot. Tributo was the tax, polo y servicio was forced labor of 40 days a year (later 15). Galleon trade: Manila to Acapulco from 1565 to 1815, silk and porcelain from China for Mexican silver. Reducciones: pinagsama-sama ang mga tao sa pueblo malapit sa simbahan para madaling kontrolin. Mga gobernador-heneral ang namumuno, at ang Real Audiencia ang pinakamataas na hukuman.

History: Martial Law and EDSA 1986 (Readings in Philippine History)

Martial law was declared on September 21, 1972 (Proclamation 1081, signed 1972 pero inanunsyo noong 23rd). Mga sanhi na ibinigay ng gobyerno: communist threat, lawlessness. Naging effect: curfew, closed media, arrests of critics and activists, dissolution of Congress.

Snap election was called in February 1986. The 1986 People Power Revolution at EDSA happened February 22 to 25, 1986 after the defection of Enrile and Ramos and the call by Cardinal Sin on Radio Veritas. Corazon Aquino took her oath as president on February 25. Exam tip from the prof: know the dates, the people, and the effects on ordinary Filipinos, not just the timeline.

NSTP 1 reminders

CWTS (Civic Welfare Training Service) focuses on community service; LTS is literacy training; ROTC is military training. Two semesters, 25 hours of community immersion in NSTP 2. Attendance counts: 3 absences and bagsak. Wear the NSTP shirt on Saturdays.

NSTP activity: tree planting

Saturday, 6:00 AM sa Marikina watershed, meet at the school gate at 5:00 AM for the shuttle. Bring gloves, a water bottle, a hat and a sack lunch. Wear closed shoes. The seedlings (narra at molave) will be provided; our group will plant 40. Fill in the attendance sheet with the class officer before leaving.

NSTP: first aid basics

Check for danger, check response, call for help. CPR for adults: 30 chest compressions then 2 rescue breaths, at a rate of 100 to 120 compressions per minute, pindutin ng mga 5 cm ang dibdib. For a sprain use RICE: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation. For a nosebleed, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose for 10 minutes; huwag ihiga nang nakatingala. Burns: cool running water for 10 minutes, no toothpaste.

Accounting: the basic equation and debit/credit rules

Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity. Every transaction keeps the equation in balance. Debit means left side, credit means right side. Debit increases assets and expenses; credit increases liabilities, equity and revenue. Normal balances: assets and expenses are debit, liabilities, equity and revenue are credit.

Example: owner invests P50,000 cash. Debit Cash 50,000, credit Capital 50,000. Bought supplies on account for P3,000: debit Supplies, credit Accounts Payable. Paid rent P5,000 cash: debit Rent Expense, credit Cash. After posting, prepare the trial balance: total debits must equal total credits. Kapag hindi pantay, hanapin ang transposition error, ang difference na divisible by 9 ay madalas na transposition. Next, adjusting entries, then the financial statements.

Accounting: bonds payable

A bond is a long-term debt: the company borrows from investors and promises to pay the face value on the maturity date plus interest every period. If the market rate is higher than the stated rate the bond sells at a discount; if lower, at a premium. Discount is amortized over the life of the bond so interest expense goes up each year. Journal on issuance: debit Cash, debit Discount on Bonds Payable, credit Bonds Payable.

Accounting: straight-line depreciation

Depreciation per year = (Cost - Salvage value) / Useful life. Example: delivery van P600,000, salvage P100,000, life 5 years gives P100,000 a year. Book value = cost minus accumulated depreciation. Entry: debit Depreciation Expense, credit Accumulated Depreciation. Land is not depreciated.

Finals plan (3 days)

Day by day: use 25-minute Pomodoro blocks with 5 minutes of rest, 4 blocks then a long break. Review past quizzes first, then the topics na mababa ang score ko. Sleep before the exam, huwag mag-all-nighter. Prepare bag, calculator and ID the night before.
